summary: Clarifies when SIP header fields must use the name-addr form rather than addr-spec. The rule was copied as prose in several places and missed in one. It states the constraint generically for all such header fields, updating RFC 3261 and several extension RFCs.

eli5.summary: A rule about how to write addresses was copied many times and missed once. This writes it down once for all.

questions: when to use name-addr in sip
